name: vibecraft
description: 3D status monitor for the Claude Code sessions running in your terminals
author: nearcyan

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:rust
scripts.test: npm run build:client && npm run test:rust && npm run test:unit
scripts.bench: npm run build:rust && cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --example hook_bench && cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --example server_bench
